findings.title: Solution has no test project; order import and pricing paths are untested
findings.evidence: test_inventory.py: 0 test projects, 0 test files; untested critical units: OrderImportService (data-mutation), PricingService (payment), QuoteService (payment)
findings.impact: A change to import validation, discounts or tax can reach production without any automated check, so pricing errors are found by customers.
findings.remediation: Add OrderService.Api.Tests (xUnit) with characterization tests around OrderImportService.ImportOrders and PricingService totals, and run dotnet test in CI on pull requests.
